artifacts.title: Aven and Dively v. Ohio Valley Presbytery
artifacts.synopsis: Two ministers complained that Ohio Valley Presbytery erred in granting TE Hickey an exception to Larger Catechism 177 regarding admission of covenant children to the Lord's Supper. The SJC neither sustained nor denied the complaint, remanding the case to the Presbytery because the record was insufficient to evaluate the minister's particular expression of his paedocommunion view.

artifacts.synopsis: RE Gerald Hedman complained that Pacific Northwest Presbytery unconstitutionally adopted five not-guilty verdicts regarding TE Peter Leithart's teachings on baptism, covenants, imputation, justification, and union with Christ. The SJC denied the complaint, finding it was bound by the Record of the Case and that Complainant had not demonstrated clear error on the part of Presbytery, with concurring and dissenting opinions discussing the scope of review, standing, and concerns about Leithart's sacramental theology.

artifacts.synopsis: Rocky Mountain Presbytery sustained a candidate's ordination exam who held the view that women could teach (but not preach or exercise authority) in church ministries under the authority of the church session. TE James Urish complained that Presbytery erred in sustaining the candidate's exam. The SJC affirmed Presbytery's decision, finding no clear error, as neither the Westminster Standards nor the BCO explicitly address this specific application of 1 Timothy 2:12.

artifacts.title: Ordination vows require compliance with Assembly rules of order

matches.evidence: The CCB advised that delegates are bound by ordination vows to follow PCA constitutional rules, and that changing unscriptural standards requires proper amendment procedures, not suspension.
